Scoping a medical billing agreement

Before formal review, make an operational checklist that shows what the billing partner will do and what your practice will retain.

In this guide
Draw the working boundarySpecify the working arrangementPrepare for handover

Draw the working boundary

Walk through eligibility checks, charge entry, claim submission, follow-up, payment posting and reporting. Mark each step with an owner. Include old accounts receivable and unresolved claims already on the books.

Specify the working arrangement

Agree how the parties will exchange records, grant and remove access, handle incidents and route clinical questions. Request an example report and agree on the definitions behind important measures. Set a meeting schedule that suits both teams.

Prepare for handover

Ask how open queues, reports and access will be returned at exit. Capture the proposed fee basis and exclusions in writing. Give the scope and draft terms to your organisation’s authorised reviewers before signing.
